name: Spatiotemporal Kernel Prediction Network for VPT
definition: A deep learning denoiser for Volume Path Tracing (VPT) image sequences that uses a dual-stream encoder to process G-buffers and radiance separately, and a Multi-Head Spatiotemporal Kernel Prediction Layer (MSKPL) to predict per-pixel temporal and spatial filter kernels for adaptive denoising.
summary: Spatiotemporal Kernel Prediction Network for VPT is a deep learning denoiser that uses dual-stream encoding and kernel prediction to adaptively filter volume path tracing sequences, reducing color bias by decoupling auxiliary features from radiance.
